lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu na chukaee mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: Their attachment to Maya does not cease; they die, only to be reborn, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਤਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤਜਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sev sukh paaiaa at tisanaa taj vikaar ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is found; intense desire and corruption are discarded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran kaa dukh gaiaa jan naanak sabad beechaar ||49||
lines.translation: The pains of death and birth are taken away; servant Nanak reflects upon the Word of the Shabad. ||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhiaai man har daragah paavahi maan ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal being, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kilavikh paap sabh kateeahi haumai chukai gumaan ||
lines.translation: All your sins and terrible mistakes shall be taken away, and you shall be rid of your pride and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh kamal vigasiaa sabh aatam braham pachhaan ||
lines.translation: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, realizing God, the Soul of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: har har kirapaa dhaar prabh jan naanak jap har naam ||50||
lines.translation: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant the Name of the Lord. ||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਧਨਵੰਤੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree dhanava(n)tee jaaneeai bhaaee jaa(n) satigur kee kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: In Dhanaasaree, the soul-bride is known to be wealthy, O Siblings of Destiny, when she works for the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸਉਪੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਉ ਭਾਈ ਲਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਫਿਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man saupe jee sau bhaaee lae hukam phiraau ||
lines.translation: She surrenders her body, mind and soul, O Siblings of Destiny, and lives according to the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਵਹਿ ਬੈਸਹ ਭਾਈ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah baisaavahi baisah bhaaee jah bhejahi tah jaau ||
lines.translation: I sit where He wishes me to sit, O Siblings of Destiny; wherever He sends me, I go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: evad dhan hor ko nahee bhaaee jevad sachaa naau ||
lines.translation: There is no other wealth as great, O Siblings of Destiny; such is the greatness of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾਂ ਭਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sache ke gun gaavaa(n) bhaaee sadaa sache kai sa(n)g rahaau ||
lines.translation: I sing forever the Glorious Praises of the True Lord; I shall remain with the True One forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਨਣੁ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: painan gun cha(n)giaaeeaa bhaaee aapanee pat ke saad aape khaai ||
lines.translation: So wear the clothes of His Glorious Virtues and goodness, O Siblings of Destiny; eat and enjoy the flavor of your own honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa kiaa saalaaheeai bhaaee darasan kau bal jaai ||
lines.translation: How can I praise Him, O Siblings of Destiny? I am a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vich vadeeaa vadiaaeeaa bhaaee karam milai taa(n) paai ||
lines.translation: Great is the Glorious Greatness of the True Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; if one is blessed with good karma, He is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਭਾਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik hukam ma(n)n na jaananee bhaaee doojai bhaai phiraai ||
lines.translation: Some do not know how to submit to the Hukam of His Command, O Siblings of Destiny; they wander around lost in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਢੋਈ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਾਈ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)gat dhoee naa milai bhaaee baisan milai na thaau ||
lines.translation: They find no place of rest in the Sangat, O Siblings of Destiny; they find no place to sit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਾ ਧੁਰੇ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam tinaa manaaisee bhaaee jinaa dhure kamaaiaa naau ||
lines.translation: Nanak: they alone submit to His Command, O Siblings of Destiny, who are pre-destined to live the Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: tinh vitahu hau vaariaa bhaaee tin kau sad balihaarai jaau ||51||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to them, O Siblings of Destiny, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||51||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਦਾੜੀਆਂ ਸਚੀਆ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਗੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: se daaReeaa(n) sacheeaa j gur charanee laga(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: Those beards are true, which brush the feet of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦਿ ਰਹੰਨੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sevan gur aapanaa anadin anad raha(n)nhi ||
lines.translation: Those who serve their Guru night and day, live in bliss, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਮੁਹ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਨੑਿ ॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak se muh sohane sachai dar disa(n)nhi ||52||
lines.translation: O Nanak, their faces appear beautiful in the Court of the True Lord. ||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਖ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੁ ਦਾੜੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukh sache sach daaReeaa sach bolahi sach kamaahi ||
lines.translation: True are the faces and true are the beards, of those who speak the Truth and live the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਂਹਿ ਸਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad man vasiaa satigur maa(n)hi samaa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: The True Word of the Shabad abides in their minds; they are absorbed in the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਚੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee raasee sach dhan utam padavee paa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: True is their capital, and true is their wealth; they are blessed with the ultimate status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sunahi sach ma(n)n lain sachee kaar kamaahi ||
lines.translation: They hear the Truth, they believe in the Truth; they act and work in the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣਾ ਸਚੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee daragah baisanaa sache maahi samaahi ||
lines.translation: They are given a place in the Court of the True Lord; they are absorbed in the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin satigur sach na paaeeai manamukh bhoole jaa(n)hi ||53||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the True Lord is not found. The self-willed manmukhs leave, wandering around lost. ||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa priu priu kare jalanidh prem piaar ||
lines.translation: The rainbird cries, "Pri-o! Pri-o! Beloved! Beloved!" She is in love with the treasure, the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭਿ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur mile seetal jal paaiaa sabh dookh nivaaranahaar ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the cooling, soothing water is obtained, and all pain is taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis chukai sahaj oopajai chukai kook pukaar ||
lines.translation: My thirst has been quenched, and intuitive peace and poise have welled up; my cries and screams of anguish are past.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖਹੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh saa(n)t hoi naam rakhahu ur dhaar ||54||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are peaceful and tranquil; they enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within their hearts. ||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਤੂੰ ਸਚੁ ਚਉ ਸਚੇ ਸਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabeehaa too(n) sach chau sache sau liv laai ||
lines.translation: O rainbird, chirp the True Name, and let yourself be attuned to the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: boliaa teraa thaai pavai guramukh hoi alaai ||
lines.translation: Your word shall be accepted and approved, if you speak as Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad cheen tikh utarai ma(n)n lai rajaai ||
lines.translation: Remember the Shabad, and your thirst shall be relieved; surrender to the Will of the Lord.
